# **4.3. Monotone Traffic.** This 

example is a special case of a continuous-time road traffic analysis problem used as a reachability benchmark in [5]. This problem investigates the density of traffic on a single lane over a time range over four periods of duration _T_ using the Cell Transmission Model [7] that divides the road into _n_ equal segments. The spatially discretized model is an _n_ -dimensional dynamical system with states _x_ 1 _, . . . , xn_ , where _xi_ represents the density of traffic in the _i_<sup>_th_</sup> segment. Traffic enters segment through _x_ 1 and flows through each successive segment before leaving through segment _n_ .
